description: Engine-exact answers from Godot 4.7's own GDScript language server (kept warm for 10 minutes; the first call takes a few seconds). op `diagnostics`: errors and warnings at the project's warning levels, as `res://x.gd:12:5: warning [UNUSED_VARIABLE] ...`, for `file` or every script. op `hover`: the type or signature at `line`/`column` (1-based; a tab is one column). op `definition`: where the name there is declared, as res://file:line, or that it is an engine symbol. op `completion`: what can follow there (members after a dot, node paths after $), up to `limit`. Pass `code` to analyse unsaved text as `file` without writing it. Needs Godot. Like opening the editor, Godot imports the project: it updates .godot/ and adds a missing .import file next to each asset and a missing .uid file next to each script. A new class_name, a changed project.godot or a new asset restarts the server. Without Godot use godot_review; to load scenes too use godot_check.

code.description: unsaved GDScript to analyse as `file` instead of the file on disk; nothing is written

column.description: 1-based column; a tab is one column (hover, definition, completion)

file.description: the .gd file: res:// path or a path (diagnostics without it: every script)

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

name: godot_code
title: Ask Godot's GDScript language server
